inner_equi_join.sql: SELECT o.order_id, s.segment, o.customer AS customer FROM orders AS o INNER JOIN segments AS s ON o.customer = s.customer ORDER BY o.order_id, s.segment
inner_equi_join.ordering: ORDER BY order_id, segment is explicit; no other row ordering is assumed.
inner_equi_join.null_key_rule: SQL equality does not match NULL to NULL; order 2 and the null-key segment row do not join.
inner_equi_join.duplicate_matches: Both matching alice segment rows are retained.
